verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms MX serves an llms.txt at docs.mx.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured markdown index of the documentation, including 152 product pages. The doc pages themselves are served as .md files, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-readable docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering (e.g., an llms-full.txt or usage guidance), and independent corroboration beyond the probe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
